2.88.36
Chart.NoRowsMessage
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Chart.NoRowsMessage element is ignored. The Chart.ChartNoDataMessage element MUST be
used instead.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.NoRowsMessage element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.NoRowsMessage element.
 <xsd:element name="NoRowsMessage" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
